verdict.rationale: A knowledge-base app could plausibly ship an AI assistant that acts as an MCP client, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has no mention of MCP or of connecting external tool servers. The plugin marketplace, local HTTP API and logseq:// protocol are adjacent extensibility features, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
